security_audit.summary: Static analysis produced many pattern matches, but most are false positives from Markdown backticks, template text, and validation variable names. The confirmed behavior is local archive creation in package_skill.py; no prompt injection, network access, credential handling, or destructive behavior was found.

remediation.issue: The packaging script includes every regular file found under the selected skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Skip symlinks and document that authors should package only reviewed skill folders without secrets or temporary files.

content.value_statement: Building useful AI skills requires clear triggers, concise instructions, and tested resources. This skill guides creation, validation, and packaging for reusable Codex workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required structure for a Codex skill folder.
Guides authors through skill naming, frontmatter, and trigger descriptions.
Helps decide when to add scripts, references, or assets.
Provides an initializer script that creates a starter skill directory.
Provides validation and packaging scripts for local skill distribution.
Gives patterns for concise skill instructions and progressive disclosure.
limitations: It does not generate domain expertise without user input or source material.
It does not publish skills to a marketplace or remote registry.
Its helper scripts modify local files under the selected output path.
It assumes Python and PyYAML are available for validation.

use_cases.title: Create a New Codex Skill
use_cases.description: Design a skill folder, frontmatter, and starter instructions for a repeatable workflow.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn internal procedures into reusable skill instructions with scripts, references, and assets.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Sharing
use_cases.description: Validate structure, improve metadata, and package a reviewed skill for distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new workflow skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-creator to create a Codex skill for reviewing pull requests. Ask only for details needed before scaffolding it.

prompt_templates.title: Add Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate design for scripts, references, and assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-creator to plan which scripts, references, and assets belong in a skill for monthly reporting workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Refine triggering, instructions, and resource layout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-creator to review this existing skill folder and update it so the trigger description and instructions are concise.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and Package a Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release preparation for a shared skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-creator to validate this skill, fix structural problems, remove placeholder files, and package it for distribution.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for recurring database migration reviews.
output: A hyphen-case skill name is selected.
A concise trigger description is drafted.
A folder plan separates review steps, reference rules, and optional scripts.

output_examples.input: Improve this skill before sharing it with a team.
output: The frontmatter is checked for required fields.
Placeholder guidance is removed or replaced.
Validation issues are listed with concrete fixes.

output_examples.input: Package a completed skill for distribution.
output: A distributable skill archive is created after validation passes.
Errors are reported before any package is produced.

best_practices: Define precise trigger conditions in the skill description.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed references into separate files.
Run validation after structural changes and before packaging.
anti_patterns: Do not place long reference material directly in SKILL.md.
Do not keep placeholder examples that are unrelated to the skill.
Do not add scripts or assets unless they support real repeated tasks.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create Codex skills with clear metadata, focused instructions, and optional reusable resources.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide edits to frontmatter, instructions, resources, validation, and packaging.

faq.question: Does it require coding knowledge?
faq.answer: Basic command line comfort helps, but the guidance explains each required skill structure step.

faq.question: Can it create scripts inside a skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The initializer can create script folders and examples when those resources are requested.

faq.question: Does it publish skills automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates, validates, and packages local skill files for later sharing.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is intended for Codex and is also listed for Claude and Claude Code compatibility.
